systems.country_label: mHealth.ci (eCHIS and other tools of the community-based health information system)
systems.platform: mHealth.ci application developed by the ICT startup Ticanalyse, commissioned by UNICEF
systems.owner: Ministry of Health (DSCPS, DIS, DISD), with UNICEF technical and financial support and Government of Canada funds
systems.tiers: community health workers and the frontline health workers (nurses and midwives) who supervise them; pilot in the five health districts of the Poro health region, about 600 end-users trained, full operational launch 8 January 2025

note: The system studied is mHealth.ci, a community health worker platform (class community), so no fact; the document says it integrates with the national health information system (DHIS2) but does not describe what DHIS2 itself reports, so DHIS2 is left unclassified.
